description: Jobs Companies Services Search jobs here LoginRegister For employers Business Analyst Veniso Solutions 1.48 Reviews 0 - 1 years Not Disclosed Hyderabad Posted: 3+ weeks ago Openings: 1 Applicants: 100+ Continue with Google Job description We are looking for an entry-level Business Analyst to support coordination between business teams, client SPOCs, and product/technical teams. This role involves learning telecom billing integrations, internet product workflows, and working with tools like Google Analytics, MIS, data analytics platforms, and issue resolution processes. Job Summary: The candidate will assist in product documentation and ensure smooth operations for apps, games, and other digital products. Key Responsibilities: Business Coordination: Act as a point of contact between business SPOCs, clients, and internal product/technical teams under guidance. Assist in understanding and supporting the integration of telecom billing solutions with product platforms. Help create and maintain business documents, such as product notes, integration templates, and reports. Assist with escalating issues and coordinating with the technical team to resolve them. Telecom Billing Integration: Support the integration of telecom billing solutions with the companys VAS products and assist in ensuring client requirements are met. Help troubleshoot any telecom billing integration issues under supervision. Product Internet Platforms: Assist in managing business operations for internet-based products, including websites, apps, games, and digital services. Learn and support the use of product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Appsflyer, Google Ads Manager, and others to track performance and user acquisition. Help monitor app and game distribution channels to track product reach and growth. Revenue Issue Management: Track revenue performance with guidance, identifying discrepancies and assisting in reporting to leadership. Support in identifying operational or product issues and assist with collaboration between business and technical teams to resolve them. Assist with data analysis to enhance product performance and uncover growth opportunities. Product Documentation Reporting: Assist in the creation and maintenance of product documentation, including integration templates, process documentation, and revenue reports. Ensure that all product and process documentation is up to date and accessible for the team. Qualifications Requirements: Experience: 0 - 1 year in business operations, telecom billing integration, or internet product management. Proficiency: Basic knowledge of telecom billing systems and integration processes. Training will be provided. Tools Knowledge: Familiarity with digital tools like Google Analytics, Appsflyer, Google Ads Manager, and product analytics will be an advantage. Additional Skills: Basic understanding of app and game distribution platforms and design tools like Canva is a plus. Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn issue escalation and resolution processes. Analytical Ability: Willingness to learn about revenue tracking, data analytics, and reporting. Expectations Cultural Fit: Mindset: Proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented with a willingness to learn. Growth Focus: Utilize self-learning tools and resources to stay updated on the latest technologies, tools, and strategies in telecom and digital services. Team Collaboration: Ability to support and coordinate with cross-functional teams, clients, and internal teams. Flexibility: Willingness to work flexible hours and shifts. Travel: Open to domestic and international travel when necessary for business operations. Growth: Transparent, collaborative, and motivated to grow within the organization. This role is ideal for recent graduates or individuals with up to 1 year of relevant experience who are passionate about business operations and the telecom/digital product space.
